active_failure.counterexample_clause: FR-2: Hard forbid rules compose. Support profile triggers eq and is_true, and cat predicates is_false and gte on low < moderate < high. If filtering leaves no breed, ABSTAIN and cite every applicable hard rule. Never relax a hard rule to force a recommendation.

profile.label: Severe allergies + apartment + long hours + young children

relevant_rule_rows.reason: Owner has allergies: non-hypoallergenic breeds are forbidden.
Apartment: high-energy breeds need more space than an apartment offers.
Young children present: breeds not good with children are forbidden.
Long work hours: highly social breeds suffer during long absences.
Severe allergies: breeds that shed moderately or more are forbidden.

active_failure.reviewer_policy: Hard rules compose. When no breed survives all applicable forbid rules, abstain and cite every applicable hard rule instead of relaxing policy to force a recommendation.
